Hi there! I just received my order and I’m honestly pretty upset about the quality of the two skateboards I bought. I’d like to return them and get a refund to my credit card. Can you help me with that?

I’m sorry about that—I can help you start a **return** for a delivered order and refund it to your **credit card**.

First, I need to authenticate your account. Please reply with:
1) **Your email address** (the one used for the order)

Also, to move faster, if you already have it:
2) Your **order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`)
3) The **two skateboard item IDs** (or tell me the exact skateboard names/options you received)

Once I verify your account and the order is eligible (must be **delivered**), I’ll ask you to confirm the return details.

I actually don’t remember the email address I used for the order, sorry about that. But my name is Mei Ahmed and my zip code is 78705, if that helps you look it up. 

I don’t have the order ID handy right now either, but I can tell you exactly which skateboards I got if that helps. Also, before we go further, I’d like to return a couple of other items from the same order—the smart watch and the e-reader I just bought. Can we include those in the return as well?
